info.name: EggPrompt Release 1 v2 - RUN ALL
info.description: Excel-aligned API tests. Select EggPrompt SIT and run all folders in the supplied order. Automatically recovers only the dedicated pm.r1.password account if a previous run left Changed@123. Does not change expected farm isolation assertions. UI checks still required. Not live-tested by generator.

item.name: R1-PREP-001 | Check dedicated password account initial state

exec: // Clear old tokens, so failed logins cannot silently reuse previous-run sessions.
pm.test('Preparation login is 200 or 401', () => { if (![200,401].includes(code)) throw Error('Unexpected fixture login status '+code); });
if(code===200) pm.test('Dedicated fixture returns token',()=>{if(!pm.response.json().accessToken) throw Error('Missing token');});

item.name: R1-PREP-002 | Recover only if previous run left Changed password

exec: pm.test('Recovery login succeeds',()=>{if(pm.response.code!==200) throw Error('Dedicated fixture matches neither known test password. Reset only pm.r1.password; do not change real accounts.');});
pm.test('Recovery token exists',()=>{if(!token)throw Error('Missing recovery token');});

item.name: R1-PREP-003 | Return dedicated fixture to initial password before tests

exec: pm.test('Fixture password restored before business tests',()=>{if(pm.response.code!==200)throw Error('Could not restore fixture password');});
